profile.summary: Avro India Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of plastic molded furniture and granules in India. The company provides chairs, tables, stools, gold, cushion, armless chair, baby chair, matt and gloss, round table, plastic cabinets, shoe racks, and kid's chairs. It also offers dining table and almirah. Avro India Limited offers its products under the AVON FURNITURE and AVRO FURNITURE brand
